summary.inference: Approximate pointwise 95% Student-t intervals across independent whole-run seeds; refinement differences are paired by seed. Intervals are withheld when no sampling spread is observed above floating resolution; identical finite samples cannot bound rare tails. No independent-ion confidence interval, simultaneous band or experimental validation is implied.
